description: Procurement for the purchase of 75 Motor Graders
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-02-23 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - As per the approval granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2025-10-21, bids have been invited by following the National Competitive Bidding Procedure for the purchase of 75 Motor Graders to be utilized for development programmes of the Government. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development to award the said procurement to United Tractors & Equipment (Private) Limited for a sum of Rs.1,424.25 million (excluding VAT), based on the recommendation made by the Standing High Level Procurement Committee after evaluation of the bids submitted, was approved by the Cabinet.
